reviews.text: This cream is really amazing. There are many creams that trend every month or many staples that people always mention, but I don't see this cream being put enough. Love that this comes with a spatula, love the bundle and how my skin loves it. It feels heavy at the beginning and takes a little to absorb but it nourishes and hydrates my skin perfectly without being greasy. I don't need too much to cover my whole face and neck so I think this product will last me a long time.
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜真係好正。每個月都有好多面霜大熱或者好多被人經常提到嘅王牌，但我覺得呢款被提及嘅次數真係唔夠。附送嘅刮棒我好鍾意，套裝好正，我嘅皮膚都好鍾意。一開始用覺得有啲厚重，吸收需要少少時間，但滋潤同保濕效果一流，唔會油笠。搽勻成塊面同頸唔需要好多，估計呢枝可以用好耐。

reviews.text: I have been trying to find a new moisturizer for the wintertime here in the Midwest. The emulsion-type moisturizer that I normally use in the summer just isn't enough for my skin right now. I have combination skin that is prone to dehydration, and I have been looking for a product that offers skin barrier support and enough moisture for my skin to satisfy it without overwhelming it. I just got this product not too long ago and I am already seeing my skin change for the better. It's looking healthier and more moisturized. This moisturizer seals in my other products but is still light enough to be worn under my sunscreen. After testing out several creams, I think I have finally found what I am looking for.
reviews.zh: 我一直想搵一款新嘅保濕產品過中西部嘅冬天。夏天用開嘅乳液型保濕而家已經唔夠。我係混合性肌膚，皮膚容易缺水，幾個月嚟都喺搵一款可以強化皮膚屏障、保濕力夠但又唔會太厚重嘅產品。我啱啱買咗呢款冇耐，已經見到皮膚明顯變好，望落更健康、更保濕。呢款保濕霜可以鎖住之前用嘅產品，但質地夠輕，可以再搽防曬。試咗咁多款面霜之後，我覺得終於搵到想要嘅嘢。

reviews.text: Different from the Birch Juice one, make sure you double check to confirm you’re buying the right one. This one is white and the other one has a green/blueish tint. I personally liked the one with the Birch Juice, it felt more hydrating and refreshing, this one feels a bit thicker!
reviews.zh: 呢款同 Birch Juice 嗰款唔同，記得睇清楚買啱。呢款係白色，嗰款帶綠色/藍色調。我個人就鍾意 Birch Juice 嗰款，感覺更保濕、更清爽，呢款質地就厚少少！

reviews.text: this product left my skin feeling super oily as if i haven’t properly washed my face and it broke me out a lot. idk how it is for other people but i just know it wasn’t for me
reviews.zh: 呢款產品用完之後皮膚成面油，好似冇洗乾淨塊面咁，而且爆咗好多瘡。其他人點我就唔知，但我自己就知唔啱我用。

reviews.text: great for people with dehydrated and sensitive skin like me! my skin gets super dry during the winter but i cant use my normal moisturizer because it becomes sensitive as well but this didn't irritate my skin at all! packaging is also so cute and the small tube of extra cream is great for traveling or to bring around.
reviews.zh: 啱晒好似我呢啲缺水同敏感肌嘅人！冬天皮膚會乾到爆，但平時用開嘅保濕產品呢段時間用又會敏感，但呢款完全冇刺激到我！包裝都好得意，細細枝額外面霜出街或者旅行帶住用都好方便。

reviews.text: The texture of the cream is much more thick than many other Korean moisturizer creams I've tried. It's not a gel/cream hybrid, it's completely cream. However, when you apply it, it thins out a bit making it feel like it's much lighter than it seems. That being said, a little goes a long way! It does have a little bit of heaviness to it, but it's not uncomfortable. An hour later, most of it has been absorbed by the skin, keeping it hydrated. It would be a great everyday moisturizer for normal/dry skin or for colder months. It may be a bit too heavy for oily skin. I use this cream in the day time to recuperate my stressed skin from retinol. It does have a calming effect when my skin is stressed.
reviews.zh: 呢隻面霜嘅質地比起我試過嘅其他韓國保濕面霜厚好多。佢唔係 gel/cream 混合型，而係完全係 cream。不過，搽上皮膚之後會薄返少少，感覺比睇落輕盈得多。雖然係咁講，份量唔使好多已經夠用！用落有少少厚重感，但唔算唔舒服。一個鐘之後，大部分已經畀皮膚吸收，令皮膚保持水潤。佢好適合中性／乾性肌或者天凍嘅月份做日常保濕霜。油性肌可能會覺得稍為太厚重。我喺日間用呢隻面霜，幫我用完視黃醇之後受壓嘅皮膚復元。當皮膚受壓時，佢有舒緩嘅效果。

reviews.text: Love this cream, repurchased a couple of times already. This is now a staple in my beauty routine along with the Birch sap cream. I like a lot of the products by Round Lab - good ingredients, they support clean beauty and focus on deep hydration and moisturision. Dokdo Cream was what made me love Round Lab. 80ml cream in tub is bigger than other brands and this set is great value with the extra mini cream.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢隻面霜，已經回購咗幾次。佢而家同 Birch sap cream 一齊成為我護膚程序嘅必備品。我好鍾意 Round Lab 嘅好多產品——成分好，佢哋支持 clean beauty，重點係深層保濕同埋滋潤。當初係 Dokdo Cream 令我愛上 Round Lab。80ml 罐裝面霜比起其他品牌大，而且呢個套裝仲有額外細裝面霜，非常抵買。

reviews.text:
Pros: I have a sensitive skin. This product does not break out my skin. It does not have any fragrance. It moisturizes my skin.

Cons: It has a thick consistency. I have a combination skin so this product will work better during winter than summer for me. When I apply this product to my skin, it kind of burns. This may be because I just changed all of my skincare products (cleasing foam, serum, lotion, emulsion, cream, etc.). I would probably need to test it longer and/or test it by itself.

So far it is a okay cream for me.
reviews.zh:
優點：我係敏感肌。呢個產品唔會令我爆瘡。佢冇任何香味。可以幫我保濕。

缺點：質地比較厚。我係混合性肌，所以呢個產品對我嚟講冬天用會好過夏天用。當我搽上皮膚時，有少少刺痛感。呢個可能係因為我啱啱轉晒所有護膚產品（潔面泡沫、精華、乳液、乳霜等）。我可能要試耐啲同／或者單獨試。

到目前為止，佢對我嚟講算係一隻 okay 嘅面霜。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
